cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My meeting email reached nobody. I've authorized a review of this office's entire communication system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's still in your drafts. Can I just send it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sending is approved. The fact that it required your intervention confirms a system-wide dependence on me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover your inbox while you have lunch. Will that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your temporary command is approved. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich; apparently my lunch is now an institutional vacancy.

reason: Use approval of B helpful repair and lunch cover to turn minor oversight into a broader institutional crisis, keeping A self-appointed rank central.
